principles: foreign paths are stale metadata on the current platform
primary lane should represent actionable healthy work
reconcile must be explicit before mutating zombie state
drivers: Windows absolute paths are not recognized by path.isAbsolute on macOS
session_brief currently chooses active story before checking zombie/runtime health
story_reconcile output lacks explicit foreign path classification

options.name: A: add foreign-path detection and filter primary zombies
pros: improves operator output without automatic state mutation

options.name: B: auto reconcile foreign-path zombies during session_brief
cons: read-only command would mutate state unexpectedly

options.name: C: only update user docs to run story_reconcile
cons: does not fix misleading primary lane or path display

chosen: A: add foreign-path detection and filter primary zombies
rationale: 选择 A，因为它修正底层 path 归一化和 primary 选择，同时仍保留 story_reconcile confirm 作为显式状态修改边界。

preMortem.scenario: 正常相对 worktree 被误判 foreign
preMortem.consequence: 健康 story 被排除 primary
preMortem.mitigation: 只匹配 Windows drive/UNC 绝对路径，不匹配 .worktrees/B-id

preMortem.scenario: zombie 仍被 primary 选中
preMortem.trigger: primary selection 不知道 zombie set
preMortem.consequence: 用户继续看到 missing artifacts 噪音
preMortem.mitigation: session_brief buildParallelBrief 输入过滤 zombieIds

preMortem.trigger: 把 foreign path 当本地目录 rmSync
preMortem.mitigation: foreign path recordedExists=false，不执行 worktree remove/rmSync，仅清 story.worktree metadata
